source: Poolheads' old GHL account (screenshots sent by Pedro 21/10): the text their IVR 'Business Hours Call Routing' sent after a missed call, verbatim. Here it is SMS 1 of our missed-call follow-up, which the new IVR triggers (tag 'missed call'), so the caller gets it once.

messages.workflow: Missed New Lead - Initial SMS Follow-up
messages.text:
Hi this is Poolheads, We are sorry we missed your call! We are either with another customer or closed, we will call you right back as soon as we can 😁

Our hours of operation are 9am to 5pm Monday thru Friday
